Homemade Taco Seasoning
By: Tracy Koslicki
Published: Wednesday, November 5, 2014 - 12:34pm

Ingredients




4 tablespoons chili powder
2 tablespoon ground cumin
4 teaspoons cornstarch
4 teaspoons kosher salt
3 teaspoons hot smoked paprika
2 teaspoon ground coriander
1 teaspoon cayenne pepper

Preparation

1 In a jar or other small container with lid, add all ingredients.  Mix or shake until well combined. 2 Store in air tight container for up to 1 month.

About

Why buy pre-packaged taco seasoning when you can make your own at home in less than 5 minutes?
